stem: She has been studying all day. She _____ be very tired now.
explanation_tr: Butun gun calistigina dair kanit var, bu yuzden 'cok yorgun olmali' anlaminda 'must' kullanilir. Must, guclu bir tahmin/cikarim ifade eder.
rule_tr: Guclu tahmin (simdiki zaman) = must + V1 (... olmali)
tip_tr: Eldeki kanitlara dayanarak '%90 eminim' diyorsan must kullan.
extra_example: He must be at home — his car is in the driveway. (Evde olmali — arabasi garaj yolunda.)

stem: You have a terrible cough. You _____ see a doctor as soon as possible.
explanation_tr: Onerme ve tavsiye icin 'should' kullanilir. Konusmaci kisiye doktora gitmesini tavsiye ediyor, emir vermiyor.
rule_tr: Tavsiye = should / ought to + V1
tip_tr: Biri sana 'ne yapmaliyim?' diye sorarsa cevap should ile baslar.
extra_example: You should drink more water if you have a headache. (Bas agrin varsa daha cok su icmelisin.)

stem: English _____ in more than 50 countries around the world.
explanation_tr: Ingilizce konusulur — ozne (English) eylemi yapan degil, eylemin yapildigi seydir. Bu yuzden edilgen (passive) yapi gerekir. Genel bir gercek oldugu icin Present Simple Passive kullanilir.
rule_tr: Present Simple Passive = am/is/are + V3 (past participle)
tip_tr: Ozne eylemi kendisi yapmiyorsa, ona bir sey 'yapiliyorsa' passive kullan.
extra_example: Rice is grown in many Asian countries. (Pirinc bircok Asya ulkesinde yetistirilir.)

stem: The new hospital _____ by the president last month.
explanation_tr: 'Last month' gecmis zaman isaretcidir ve hastane acildi (kendisi acmadi, acildi). Past Simple Passive gerekir.
rule_tr: Past Simple Passive = was/were + V3
tip_tr: 'Last week/month/year' + ozne eylemi yapmiyorsa = was/were + V3.
extra_example: The letter was sent yesterday. (Mektup dun gonderildi.)

stem: The doctor said that the patient _____ to rest for a week.
explanation_tr: Doktor 'said' dediginde ana cumle gecmis zamandadir (reported speech). Bu durumda 'needs' bir zaman geri giderek 'needed' olur.
rule_tr: Reported Speech: said + that + tense shift (Present Simple -> Past Simple)
tip_tr: Raporlama fiili gecmisteyse (said/told), icerideki zaman bir adim geriye gider.
extra_example: She said she was tired. (Yorgun oldugunu soyledi.) — 'I am tired' -> 'she was tired'

stem: The nurse asked the patient _____ any allergies.
explanation_tr: Dolayli soru (reported question) yapilirken soru cumlesi duz cumle sirasina donusur ve if/whether eklenir. 'Do you have...?' -> 'if he had...'
rule_tr: Reported Yes/No question: asked + if/whether + S + V (duz cumle sirasi, soru sirasi degil!)
tip_tr: Reported question'da ASLA soru sirasi (V+S) kullanma. Her zaman S+V sirasi olacak.
extra_example: She asked me if I liked coffee. (Bana kahveyi sevip sevmedigimi sordu.)

stem: The professor _____ teaches anatomy is very experienced.
explanation_tr: Professor bir insandir ve cumlede ozne gorevi goruyor (teaches fiilinin oznesi). Insan + ozne = 'who' kullanilir.
rule_tr: Insan + ozne pozisyonu = who / that
tip_tr: Boslugun ardindan fiil geliyorsa, bosluk ozne pozisyonundadir.
extra_example: The student who passed the exam was very happy. (Sinavi gecen ogrenci cok mutluydu.)

stem: That is the doctor _____ research on diabetes won an international award.
explanation_tr: Boslugun ardindan 'research' (arastirma) ismi geliyor ve bu arastirma doktorun arastirmasidir. Sahiplik bildirmek icin 'whose' kullanilir.
rule_tr: Sahiplik (... -in/-nin) = whose + isim
tip_tr: Bosluktan sonra isim geliyorsa ve sahiplik anlamı varsa whose kullan.
extra_example: The woman whose son is a doctor lives next door. (Oglu doktor olan kadin yan komsu.)

stem: _____ the heavy rain, the Erasmus students went on the campus tour.
explanation_tr: 'The heavy rain' bir isim grubudur (cumle degil). Zitlik + isim grubu = 'despite'. 'Although' olsaydi arkasinda cumle (S+V) gelmesi gerekirdi.
rule_tr: Despite / In spite of + isim/isim grubu | Although / Even though + cumle (S+V)
tip_tr: Bosluktan sonra isim mi cumle mi var? Isim = despite, Cumle = although.
extra_example: Despite his illness, he attended the lecture. (Hastaligina ragmen derse katildi.)

stem: She studied hard _____ she could pass the Erasmus language exam.
explanation_tr: Amac bildirmek icin 'so that + S + could/can' yapisi kullanilir. 'She could pass' bir cumledir (S+V), bu yuzden 'so that' dogrudur. 'In order to' olsaydi arkasinda fiil gelmesi gerekirdi.
rule_tr: Amac: so that + S + can/could + V1 | in order to + V1
tip_tr: Bosluktan sonra cumle (S+V) geliyorsa 'so that', fiil geliyorsa 'in order to' kullan.
extra_example: He took a taxi so that he wouldn't be late. (Gec kalmamak icin taksi tuttu.)

stem: The students avoided _____ the difficult questions until the end of the exam.
explanation_tr: 'Avoid' fiili her zaman gerund (-ing) alir. 'Avoid doing something' kaliptir.
rule_tr: avoid / enjoy / mind / suggest / finish / keep + V-ing (gerund)
tip_tr: MEGAFS grubunu hatirla: Mind, Enjoy, Give up, Avoid, Finish, Suggest = hepsi gerund ister.
extra_example: She enjoys reading medical journals. (Tip dergilerini okumaktan hoslanir.)

stem: I remember _____ my homework last night, but I can't find it now.
explanation_tr: 'Remember + gerund (-ing)' gecmiste yapilan bir seyi hatirlamak demektir. 'I remember doing' = yaptigimi hatirliyorum. 'Remember + to do' ise yapmay unutmamak (gelecek) anlamindadir.
rule_tr: remember + V-ing = gecmiste yaptigini hatirlamak | remember + to V = yapmayi unutmamak
tip_tr: Gecmiste olmus bir sey icin remember + -ing, ileride yapilacak icin remember + to.
extra_example: I remember locking the door. (Kapiyi kilitledigimi hatirliyorum.)

stem: The university is famous _____ its medical faculty and research laboratories.
explanation_tr: 'Famous' sifati her zaman 'for' edati ile kullanilir. 'Famous for something' = bir seyiyle unlu.
rule_tr: famous for / interested in / afraid of / good at / worried about
tip_tr: Sifat + edat eslesmelerini ezberle. Her sifatin kendi edati vardir.
extra_example: Turkey is famous for its historical sites. (Turkiye tarihi yerleriyle unludur.)

stem: The deadline for Erasmus applications has been _____ to March 15th.
explanation_tr: Bir son tarihi (deadline) uzatmak icin 'extend' fiili kullanilir. 'Extend a deadline' sabit bir kombinasyondur (collocation).
rule_tr: extend a deadline = son tarihi uzatmak | expand = genisletmek | increase = artirmak
tip_tr: Deadline ile kullanilan fiil 'extend'dir. Expand/increase farkli baglamlarda kullanilir.
extra_example: The professor extended the deadline for submitting the essay. (Profesor makale teslim tarihini uzatti.)

stem: The patient was _____ from the hospital after a successful surgery.
explanation_tr: Hastaneden taburcu etmek icin 'discharge' fiili kullanilir. 'Be discharged from hospital' tip terminolojisinde standart ifadedir.
rule_tr: discharge from hospital = taburcu etmek | release = serbest birakmak | dismiss = gorevden almak
tip_tr: Tip baglami + hastane = discharge. Release daha cok hapishane veya resmi islemler icindir.
extra_example: She was discharged after three days of treatment. (Uc gunluk tedaviden sonra taburcu edildi.)

passage: The Erasmus programme has significantly changed the landscape of European higher education since it was established in 1987. Every year, over 300,000 students participate in academic exchanges across Europe. Research shows that Erasmus students are 50% less likely to face long-term unemployment compared to those who do not study abroad. Moreover, the programme helps develop intercultural skills, foreign language abilities, and professional networks that prove invaluable in today's global job market. Critics, however, argue that the programme mainly benefits students from wealthier backgrounds who can afford living costs abroad.
stem: What is the main purpose of this passage?

options.text: To criticize the high cost of the Erasmus programme
To explain the history of European universities
To highlight the benefits and a criticism of the Erasmus programme
To compare employment rates in European countries
To encourage students to learn foreign languages

explanation_tr: Paragraf Erasmus programinin faydalarini anlatip sonunda bir elestiriyi de ekliyor. Yani hem olumlu hem olumsuz yonleri bir arada sunuyor.
rule_tr: Ana fikir sorusunda tum paragrafi kapsayan secenegi bul, tek bir detaya takilma.
tip_tr: Paragrafin %80'i fayda, son cumle elestiri — ikisini birden kapsayan secenegi sec.

rule_tr: Detay sorusunda metinde gecen bilgiyi bire bir ara, kendi yorumunu katma.
tip_tr: 'Less likely' ifadesini paragrafta bul ve eslestir.

options.text: It does not improve language skills.

It should be available to more countries.
It is too expensive for universities.

explanation_tr: Paragrafin son cumlesinde elestirenler programin 'mainly benefits students from wealthier backgrounds' (zengin ailelerden gelen ogrencilere fayda sagladigi) soyleniyor.
rule_tr: Critics/argue/claim gibi kelimeler gordugunde o kismin dediklerini dikkatlice oku.
tip_tr: Elestiri cumlesi genelde 'however/but/critics argue' ile baslar. Son cumleyi tekrar oku.

passage: Sleep deprivation is a growing problem among university students. Studies indicate that nearly 60% of college students report poor sleep quality, with many sleeping fewer than six hours per night. Lack of sleep affects concentration, memory, and academic performance. Furthermore, chronic sleep deprivation weakens the immune system, making students more susceptible to illnesses. Experts recommend establishing a regular sleep schedule, limiting screen time before bed, and avoiding caffeine after 4 PM. Despite these recommendations, many students continue to sacrifice sleep for studying or socializing.
stem: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a consequence of sleep deprivation?
explanation_tr: Paragrafta uyku yetersizliginin sonuclari olarak konsantrasyon, hafiza, akademik performans ve bagisiklik sistemi zayiflamasi sayiliyor. 'Kilo alma (weight gain)' hic bahsedilmiyor.
rule_tr: NOT/EXCEPT sorularinda her secenegi paragrafta tek tek ara. Bulunmayan dogru cevaptir.
tip_tr: Eleme yontemi kullan: her secenegi metinde isaretle, isaretleyemedigini sec.

stem: According to the passage, experts recommend all of the following EXCEPT _____ .
explanation_tr: Uzmanlar duzeni uyku programi, ekran suresi kisitlamasi ve saat 16'dan sonra kafein tüketiminden kacinmayi oneriyor. 'Sabah duzenli egzersiz yapmak' metinde hic gecmiyor.
rule_tr: EXCEPT sorularinda paragraftaki listeyi bul ve seceneklerle karsilastir.
tip_tr: Metinde 'recommend' kelimesini bul, ardindan gelen listeyi oku, listede olmayani sec.

rule_tr: Sayi/istatistik sorusunda metindeki rakami bul ve aynen eslestirecek secenegi sec.
tip_tr: Yuzde icerikli sorularda metinde % isareti veya 'percent' kelimesini ara.

passage: Telemedicine, the practice of providing healthcare services through digital communication, has seen rapid growth in recent years. Patients can now consult with doctors via video calls without leaving their homes. This is particularly beneficial for elderly patients and those living in rural areas with limited access to medical facilities. However, telemedicine has limitations: physical examinations cannot be conducted remotely, and not all patients have the technological literacy or internet access required. Despite these challenges, healthcare professionals believe that telemedicine will become an essential part of modern medicine.
stem: What can be inferred from the passage about telemedicine?

options.text: It will completely replace traditional medicine.
It is useful but has certain limitations.
All doctors prefer telemedicine over face-to-face visits.
It is too expensive for most patients.

explanation_tr: Paragraf telemedicine'in faydalarini anlatip ardindan sinirliliklerini da belirtiyor. Cikarim (inference): Faydali ama sinirli yanlari var.
rule_tr: Cikarim (inference) sorusunda metinde dogrudan yazmayanı ama metinden anlasilanı sec.
tip_tr: Asiri genellemelerden kacin (completely, all, only). Dengeli secenekler genelde doğrudur.

rule_tr: 'Particularly / especially / mainly' gibi vurgu kelimelerini bul — en cok kimin icindir sorusunun cevabini verirler.
tip_tr: 'Particularly beneficial' ifadesini metinde bul.

rule_tr: Tarih/sayi sorusunda metindeki veriyi bul ve aynen eslestirecek secenegi sec.
tip_tr: Metinde '1987' rakamini bul.

stem:
Student: Excuse me, Professor. I'd like to take your elective course next semester.
Professor: _____
Student: Oh, I didn't know that. I'll register online right away then.

options.text: The course is very difficult for beginners.
You need to complete the online registration by Friday.
I don't think you're ready for it.
My office hours are on Wednesdays.
That course was cancelled last year.

explanation_tr: Ogrencinin 'I'll register online right away' (hemen online kayit olacagim) demesi, profesorun online kayit hakkinda bilgi verdigini gosteriyor. B secenegi bununla uyumlu.
rule_tr: Bosluktan SONRA gelen cevaba dikkat et. Cevap bosluktaki bilgiyi karsilamali.
tip_tr: Ogrencinin 'online' demesi anahtar kelime — profesorun de online kayittan bahsetmesi gerekir.

stem:
Patient: Good morning. I'd like to make an appointment with Dr. Yilmaz.
Receptionist: _____
Patient: Thursday afternoon would be perfect.

options.text: Dr. Yilmaz is on holiday this week.
What seems to be the problem?
He's available on Thursday afternoon or Friday morning.
You should go to the emergency room.
Your insurance doesn't cover this visit.

explanation_tr: Hasta 'Thursday afternoon would be perfect' (Persembe ogle sonrasi mukemmel olur) diyorsa, resepsiyonistin Persembe'yi bir secenek olarak sunmus olmasi gerekir.
rule_tr: Randevu diyaloglarinda cevap genellikle uygun gun/saat secenekleri icerir.
tip_tr: Hastanin 'Thursday' secmesi, onerilen seceneklerden birini sectigi anlamina gelir.

stem:
Ali: I've been looking for a part-time job near the campus.
Mehmet: _____
Ali: Really? That sounds great! Can you give me their number?

options.text: You should focus on your studies instead.
The bookshop on Main Street is hiring.
I lost my job last month.

explanation_tr: Ali'nin 'That sounds great! Can you give me their number?' demesi, Mehmet'in somut bir is firsati paylastigini gosteriyor. C secenegi kitapcinin ise aldigini soyluyor.
rule_tr: Konusmaci heyecanli tepki veriyorsa (Really? That sounds great!), karsi taraf olumlu/faydali bir bilgi vermistir.
tip_tr: 'Their number' demesi, Mehmet'in bir isletmeden bahsettigini gosterir.

stem:
Tourist: Could you recommend a good restaurant near here?
Local: _____
Tourist: Great, I love seafood. How do I get there?

options.text: There's a nice Italian restaurant, but it's very expensive.
I don't really eat out very often.
There's an excellent seafood place just two blocks away.
You should try cooking at home instead.

explanation_tr: Turistin 'I love seafood' demesi, yerel kisinin deniz urunleri restoran onerdigini gosteriyor. Ayrica 'How do I get there?' sorusu yakin bir yer tarif edildigini dogruluyor.
rule_tr: Cevaptaki anahtar kelimeyi (seafood) bir sonraki replikte ara.
tip_tr: Turistin 'seafood' demesi, onerilen restoranin deniz urunleri restorani oldugunu kanitlar.

stem:
Erasmus Student: I'm having problems with the heating in my dormitory room.
Housing Officer: _____
Erasmus Student: It's room 214 in Block B. Thank you.

options.text: You can buy a portable heater from the shop.
I'll send a technician. Which room are you in?
Heating problems are common in winter.
You should wear warmer clothes indoors.
The heating system was replaced last year.

explanation_tr: Ogrencinin oda numarasi vermesi (room 214, Block B), gorevlinin oda numarasi sordugunu gosterir. B seceneginde teknisyen gonderme + oda sorma var.
rule_tr: Cevaplayan kisi somut bilgi veriyorsa (oda numarasi), soru soran o bilgiyi istemis olmalidir.
tip_tr: 'Which room are you in?' sorusunun cevabi 'room 214 in Block B' — mantiksal eslestirme.

stem:
Student: I need to borrow this book, but my library card has expired.
Librarian: _____
Student: Sure, I have it in my bag. Here you go.

options.text: You'll need to buy a new card from the bookshop.
That book is not available for lending.
I can renew it if you show me your student ID.
You should read it here instead.

explanation_tr: Ogrencinin 'Sure, I have it in my bag' demesi, kutuphanecinin bir belge/kimlik istedigini gosterir. C secenegi ogrenci kimligini gostermesini istiyor.
rule_tr: 'I have it in my bag' → biri bir sey (belge, kimlik) istedi demektir.
tip_tr: Ogrencinin cantasindan bir sey cikarip vermesi, istenilen seyin fiziksel bir belge oldugunu gosterir.

stem:
Doctor: I'd recommend getting a flu vaccination before winter.
Patient: Is it really necessary?
Doctor: _____
Patient: Alright, I'll get it done this week.

options.text: It's your choice, but the flu can be serious for some people.
I don't really believe in vaccinations.
You should eat more fruits and vegetables.
Winter is usually cold in this region.
The pharmacy is open until 6 PM.

explanation_tr: Hastanin 'I'll get it done this week' demesi, doktorun ikna edici ama zorlayici olmayan bir cevap verdigini gosterir. A secenegi 'Senin secimin ama ciddi olabilir' diyor.
rule_tr: Doktor tavsiyesinde genellikle risk bilgisi + karar hastanin seklinde iletisim kurulur.
tip_tr: Hasta 'Alright' diyorsa, ikna olmus demektir. Doktor mantikli bir gerekce sunmus olmalidir.

stem:
Ayse: I'm struggling with the statistics assignment. It's due tomorrow!
Carlos: _____
Ayse: That would be amazing! Can we meet at the library at 5?

options.text: Statistics is really hard for everyone.
I finished mine already. I can help you with it.
Maybe you can ask the professor for an extension.

explanation_tr: Ayse'nin 'That would be amazing! Can we meet...' demesi, Carlos'un yardim teklif ettigini gosterir. B secenegi 'Ben bitirdim, sana yardim edebilirim' diyor.
rule_tr: Heyecanli kabul + bulusma teklifi = karsi taraf somut bir yardim onerisi yapmistir.
tip_tr: 'Can we meet at the library?' sorusu, birlikte calisma plani oldugunu gosterir.

stem:
Student: The Wi-Fi in the dormitory has been down for three days.
IT Support: _____
Student: Okay, but please fix it soon. We have online exams next week.

options.text: Have you tried turning your computer off and on?
We're aware of the issue. The technicians are working on it.
You can use the library's Wi-Fi instead.
Wi-Fi problems are very common these days.

explanation_tr: Ogrencinin 'please fix it soon' (lutfen cabuk duzelt) demesi, IT destegin sorunun farkinda oldugunu ve uzerinde calisildigini soylemis oldugunu gosterir.
rule_tr: Sikayet diyaloglarinda 'fix it soon' gibi ifadeler, karsi tarafin sorunla ilgilendigini dogrulamistir.
tip_tr: 'Okay, but please fix it soon' → kabul etmis ama acelesini vurguluyor.

stem:
Selin: What do you think about living abroad for a year?
Emma: _____
Selin: I agree. The cultural experience alone makes it worthwhile.

options.text: I think it's a waste of time and money.
I believe it's an incredible opportunity for personal growth.
I've never thought about it, actually.
I prefer staying in my hometown forever.

explanation_tr: Selin 'I agree' (katiliyorum) ve 'the cultural experience alone makes it worthwhile' diyor. Bu, Emma'nin olumlu bir fikir belirttigini gosterir.
rule_tr: 'I agree' demek, iki kisinin ayni gorusu paylasmasi demektir.
tip_tr: Selin'in 'I agree' + olumlu yorum yapması, Emma'nin da olumlu konusmus oldugunu kanitlar.

stem: You accidentally spill coffee on your classmate's notebook during a break. You feel terrible about it. What would you say?

options.text: It's just a notebook, don't worry about it.
You shouldn't have left it on the table.
I'm so sorry! Let me buy you a new one.
That's what happens when you're not careful.
Coffee stains can be cleaned easily.

explanation_tr: Baskasinin esyasina zarar verdiginde ozur dileyip telafi teklif etmek uygun davranistir. 'I'm so sorry! Let me buy you a new one.' hem ozur hem cozum sunuyor.
rule_tr: Hata yaptiginda: 1) Ozur dile 2) Telafi teklif et
tip_tr: Durumsal sorularda 'You feel terrible' gibi ipuclari ozur gerektiren bir durum oldugunu gosterir.

stem: You see an elderly woman carrying heavy bags near the university entrance. She looks like she is struggling. What would you say?

options.text: You should use a shopping cart next time.
Can I help you carry those bags?
Be careful, you might hurt your back.

explanation_tr: Yardima ihtiyaci olan birini gordugunuzde yardim teklif etmelisiniz. 'Can I help you carry those bags?' kibar ve dogrudan bir yardim teklifidir.
rule_tr: Yardim teklifi: Can I help you...? / Would you like me to...? / Let me help you...
tip_tr: 'Struggling' (zorlanmak) kelimesi yardim teklifi gerektiren bir durum isaretcidir.

stem: Your Erasmus roommate tells you that he has been feeling homesick since he arrived. What would you say to comfort him?

options.text: You should go back to your country then.
It's completely normal to feel that way. It will get better with time.
Homesickness is a sign of weakness.
Just forget about your family and focus on studies.

explanation_tr: Ev hasreti ceken birine empati gostermek ve umut vermek en uygun yaklasimdir. B secenegi 'Boyle hissetmek tamamen normal, zamanla duzulecek' diyor.
rule_tr: Teselli: 1) Hislerini onayla (It's normal) 2) Umut ver (It will get better)
tip_tr: 'Comfort' (teselli etmek) kelimesi empatik ve destekleyici bir cevap gerektirdigini gosterir.

stem: A friend invites you to a party tonight, but you have an important exam tomorrow morning. What would you say?

options.text: Parties are a waste of time anyway.
I'd love to, but I need to study for my exam tomorrow. Maybe next time?
I never go to parties during the week.
Sure, I'll come. Exams aren't that important.

explanation_tr: Kibar bir redde oncelikle istek belirtilir (I'd love to), sonra neden red yapildigini aciklayip alternatif sunulur (Maybe next time?).
rule_tr: Kibar red: I'd love to, but... / I'm afraid I can't because... / Maybe next time
tip_tr: Kibar redlerde 3 adim: 1) Istegi belirt 2) Nedeni acikla 3) Alternatif sun.

stem: Your classmate has just received a scholarship for her outstanding academic performance. What would you say?

options.text: Scholarships are easy to get these days.
How much money does it include?
I applied for that scholarship too.
Academic performance doesn't matter in the real world.

explanation_tr: Basari kazanmis birine tebrik etmek sosyal bir gorevdir. 'Congratulations! You really deserve it.' hem kutlama hem hak ettigini vurguluyor.
rule_tr: Tebrik: Congratulations! / Well done! / I'm so happy for you!
tip_tr: Basari haberi + 'What would you say?' = tebrik ifadesi beklenir.

stem: You and your Erasmus friends want to do something fun this weekend but nobody has any ideas. What would you say?

options.text: I don't care what we do.
Weekends are boring in this city.
How about visiting the old town? I've heard it's really beautiful.
Let's just stay home and do nothing.
I'm too tired to go anywhere.

explanation_tr: Hicbir fikri olmayan gruba somut bir oneri sunmak en uygun davranistir. 'How about visiting the old town?' kibar bir oneri + gerekce iceriyor.
rule_tr: Oneri: How about + V-ing? / Why don't we...? / We could... / Let's...
tip_tr: Durumda 'nobody has any ideas' = biri inisiyatif alip oneri sunmali.

stem: During a class discussion, the teacher asks for your opinion on online education versus traditional education. What would you say?

options.text: I don't know anything about it.
In my opinion, both have advantages, but traditional education provides better social interaction.
I agree with whatever the teacher says.
This isn't an interesting topic to discuss.

explanation_tr: Sinif tartismasinda dengeli ve gerekçeli bir fikir sunmak beklenir. C secenegi 'Bence ikisinin de avantajlari var ama...' diyerek dengeli bir goruş bildiriyor.
rule_tr: Fikir belirtme: In my opinion / I believe / From my point of view + gerekce
tip_tr: Akademik tartismada asiri keskin veya kayitsiz cevaplar uygun degildir.

stem: You are 15 minutes late to a lecture. The door is closed and the class has already started. What would you say when you enter?

options.text: The bus was late, it's not my fault.
Sorry I'm late. May I come in, please?
Why did you start without me?
I'm here now, so let's continue.
I'll just sit at the back quietly.

explanation_tr: Derse gec kaldiginda once ozur dileyip sonra izin istemek gerekir. 'Sorry I'm late. May I come in?' hem ozur hem resmi izin isteme iceriyor.
rule_tr: Gec kalma: Sorry I'm late + izin isteme (May I come in?)
tip_tr: Resmi ortamda 'May I...?' kullan, 'Can I...?' daha informeldir.

stem: You ordered a vegetarian meal at a restaurant, but the waiter brought you a meat dish instead. What would you say?

options.text: I'm never coming back here again.
Excuse me, I think there's been a mistake. I ordered the vegetarian option.
I'll eat this instead, it doesn't matter.
Can I speak to the manager immediately?

explanation_tr: Kibar bir sikayette once dikkat cekmek (Excuse me), sonra sorunu aciklamak gerekir. C secenegi 'Hata olmus saniyorum, ben vejetaryen secenegi siparis ettim' diyor.
rule_tr: Kibar sikayet: Excuse me + I think there's been a mistake/misunderstanding + sorunu acikla
tip_tr: Agresif ton yerine kibar ama net bir sikayet her zaman dogru cevaptir.

stem: Your professor spent extra time after class to help you understand a difficult topic. What would you say as you leave?

options.text: Thank you so much for your time, Professor. I really appreciate it.
Can we do this again next week?
I still don't fully understand it.

explanation_tr: Biri senin icin ekstra zaman ve emek harcadiginda samimi bir tesekkur gerekir. B secenegi hem tesekkur hem takdir iceriyor.
rule_tr: Guclu tesekkur: Thank you so much / I really appreciate it / That was very kind of you
tip_tr: 'Extra time' = ekstra emek harcamis, guçlu bir tesekkur beklenir.

stem: (I) Regular physical exercise has numerous health benefits for university students. (II) It reduces stress, improves concentration, and boosts overall energy levels. (III) The university cafeteria offers a variety of healthy meal options at affordable prices. (IV) Even 30 minutes of walking per day can make a significant difference. (V) Therefore, students should try to incorporate some form of physical activity into their daily routine.
explanation_tr: Paragraf fiziksel egzersizin faydalari hakkinda. III. cumle universite kafeteryasinin yemek seceneklerinden bahsediyor ki bu egzersiz konusuyla ilgisiz.
rule_tr: Paragrafin ana konusunu belirle, o konuyla alakasiz cumleyi bul.
tip_tr: Ilk cumle genelde konuyu verir. Her cumleyi o konuyla test et.

stem: (I) Learning a foreign language opens up many career opportunities in today's global economy. (II) Multilingual employees are highly valued by international companies. (III) The best time to visit European countries is during the summer months. (IV) Studies show that learning a second language also improves cognitive abilities and memory. (V) For these reasons, universities strongly encourage students to learn at least one foreign language.
explanation_tr: Paragraf yabanci dil ogrenmenin faydalari hakkinda. III. cumle Avrupa'yi ziyaret etmenin en iyi zamani hakkinda — dil ogrenme konusuyla ilgisiz.
rule_tr: Ana konu: yabanci dil + faydalar. Seyahat zamani bu konunun disinda.
tip_tr: Her cumleyi 'Bu cumle yabanci dil ogrenme hakkinda mi?' diye test et.

stem: (I) Climate change is one of the most pressing issues facing the world today. (II) Rising temperatures are causing glaciers to melt and sea levels to rise. (III) Many scientists believe that reducing carbon emissions is essential to slow down this process. (IV) Solar energy has become much cheaper to produce over the last decade. (V) If immediate action is not taken, the consequences could be catastrophic for future generations.
explanation_tr: Paragraf iklim degisikligi ve sonuclari hakkinda. IV. cumle gunes enerjisinin maliyetinden bahsediyor — iklim degisikliginin etkileri ve aciliyet konusuyla dogrudan iliskili degil.
rule_tr: Konu: iklim degisikliginin ciddi sonuclari + onlem alma aciliyeti. Enerji maliyeti farkli bir alt konu.
tip_tr: Gunes enerjisi cevre icin faydali olabilir ama bu paragrafin ozel konusu 'iklim degisikligi tehlikesi ve acil onlem'dir.

stem: (I) Time management is a crucial skill for university students. (II) Students who plan their schedules effectively tend to achieve higher grades. (III) The university library has an extensive collection of medical journals. (IV) Using a planner or calendar app can help students keep track of deadlines and commitments. (V) In the end, good time management reduces stress and creates more time for social activities.
explanation_tr: Paragraf zaman yonetimi hakkinda. III. cumle kutuphanenin tip dergi koleksiyonundan bahsediyor — zaman yonetimiyle ilgisi yok.
rule_tr: Ana konu: zaman yonetimi. Kutuphane koleksiyonu farkli bir konudur.
tip_tr: Her cumleyi 'Bu cumle zaman yonetimi hakkinda mi?' diye sorgula.

stem: (I) A balanced diet is essential for maintaining good health and academic performance. (II) Students should consume adequate amounts of protein, vitamins, and minerals daily. (III) Skipping breakfast has been linked to poor concentration and lower test scores. (IV) Many students enjoy playing football or basketball in their free time. (V) Nutritionists recommend eating five portions of fruit and vegetables every day to stay healthy.
explanation_tr: Paragraf dengeli beslenme ve saglik hakkinda. IV. cumle ogrencilerin futbol veya basketbol oynamaktan hoslandigini soyluyor — beslenme konusuyla ilgisiz.
rule_tr: Ana konu: beslenme + saglik/akademik performans. Spor yapma aliskanligi farkli bir konudur.
tip_tr: Spor saglikla iliskili olabilir ama bu paragrafin ozel konusu 'beslenme'dir.
